notes:
よく has two main meanings: "often" and "well" (adverb of ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧).

USAGE:
1. Often, frequently (with actions)
2. Well, thoroughly (adverb of ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- よく⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read often; to read carefully
- よく⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: to understand well
- よく⟦できました→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: Well done!
- よく⟦{来|き}ました→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧: Welcome! (I'm glad you came)

FREQUENCY SCALE:
- ⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧: always
- よく: often
- ⟦{時々|ときどき}→時々：00600_tokidoki⟧: sometimes
- ⟦たまに→たまに：01276_tamani⟧: occasionally
- ⟦{全然|ぜんぜん}→全然：00598_zenzen⟧〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: never

Note: Context determines which meaning applies.
